name: zlib
description: zlib compression library — the reference gzip/DEFLATE implementation. Vendored source, built and installed via CMake (headers + static and shared libs).
check_cmd: ls "${LOCALAPPDATA:-$HOME/AppData/Local}/airgap-cpp-devkit/zlib/include/zlib.h" 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/share/airgap-cpp-devkit/zlib/include/zlib.h" 2>/dev/null || ls /opt/airgap-cpp-devkit/zlib/include/zlib.h 2>/dev/null || echo 'zlib.h not found - check install path'
platform_note: vendored source archive; requires CMake + a C toolchain (bundled in the devkit)
